Coconut Patties
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 7:32pm

Ingredients




3 cups Sugar
cup Sweetened condensed milk
cup Water
2 cups Coconut
teaspoon Vanilla
cup Chopped nuts
1 tablespoon Butter or butter substitute
3 tablespoons Cocoa

Preparation

1 Combine sugar and cocoa. Add milk and water. Boil to soft ball stage (234 238 F). Cool to room temperature. Add coconut and nuts. Add butter and flavoring. Beat until mixture begins to thicken. Drop on waxed paper in
